blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate committee on ethics and privileges has found the complaint against Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa over his prolonged absence sufficient in form and substance. In a notice, the committee said it found the complaint, as supplemented, to be in substantial compliance with the requirements under Section 17 of its rules.
